test_title: PYST 1: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 24 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: GH007 is related to KL017 in a certain way. In the same way, LM008 is related to PQ018. To which of the following is TV009 related following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/67b84912dfb7182ff212e64704e9c93462818814f7d253bd16ab1e98d1cbd066.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Logic: Each letter pair is shifted forward in the alphabet by **+4 positions**, and the number is increased by **+10**.

Here, GH007 → KL017

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61d0798afaa75720fb85e520fa200a52d2a7a106e00e65afb4f77168e9630247.png] 

For, LM008 → PQ018

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8c357b07da6351e10202d8938e30e13c8b79b40fb7971d1c89c6bccaeb3e900.png] 

Now, applying the same pattern to TV009:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8de8a2078c47051fc486faf16fc15d0fb4269acbfdd7a0255ad728726f8eaa0.png] 

So, TV009 → XZ019

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
